results.title: Full finite support and its actual degree
results.claim: All support strata and strict-chain cohomology remain. The arithmetic quotient and original degree maps are proved, including disconnected support and support cycles.

results.title: Completed prime words and support operations
results.claim: Finite, rapidly decreasing and unrestricted prime-word complexes have explicit comparison maps and kernels. Covering and transfer on support cycles produce their actual degree multiplier.

results.title: Actual class-field functor over the split spectrum
results.claim: The Connes–Consani class-field cover and coefficient sheaves extend across the full support stratum; every original marked prime and nonunit crossed-product label remains. The relative complex and its arithmetic image are calculated.

results.title: Full marked quotient metric
results.claim: The arithmetic metric is the full marked mean-zero variance. In the relative graph metric a constant k-mark channel has exact coefficient kM/(k+M); its arithmetic quotient is connected by the explicit attained map.

results.title: Prime memory before coinvariants
results.claim: Taking the two moments before rational coinvariants retains a copy of C² for every prime. The theta map, Haar completion, full higher cycles, and Euler operator kernels and cokernels are computed. The prime module is exactly lost by the specified positive completion.

results.title: Full residue duality and projective receiver
results.claim: The full local residue pairing is perfect. Its Jacobian contraction is the reflected multiplicity trace and has exactly the jet nilradical. The original matrices, duality and traces lift to finite projective modules over G_L(C), retaining every zero label.

results.title: Complete support product and diagonal
results.claim: G_Down(P)(Z) tensor_N G_Down(Q)(Z) is G_Down(P×Q)(Z). The proper blueprint product has only rectangular support; completion adds their unions. The triangle-boundary product yields relative groups Q/Z, Q², Q and an explicit diagonal pullback.

results.title: Primitive representatives and all prime defects
results.claim: Every full actual jet packet has an exact primitive representative in the original theta class. The difference is a computed affine theta relation; every prime defect has an explicit primitive Schwartz source. Joint-support endpoint H0=C² remains visible while every H1 is preserved.

results.title: Signed torsor and additive twistor receiver
results.claim: The imaginary root relation gives an explicit mu2 torsor and ternary law. Every nonbottom support keeps two root tags until the Gaussian quotient. The invariant additive algebra is Z[u,v]/(u²+v²+4), with exact odd-power and descended norm-one torus actions.

results.title: The two original primes recover every full jet
results.claim: The prime2 and prime3 characters, each multiplied by its explicit p^(-1/2) factor, give a surjection from the real squared norm-one torus coordinate algebra onto every finite reflected zero packet, retaining all multiplicities. Critical factors have real residue field; reflected off-critical pairs have complex residue field. The lifted full-support spectrum map is a proper dense embedding, with the finite arithmetic packet closed inside V(e).

results.title: Every finite mixed covariance and quotient determinant
results.claim: For arbitrary finite factors, every proper support subset S contributes its exact block dimension q_S and amplitude eigenvalue alpha_S. The full characteristic polynomial and attained quotient determinant are evaluated before imposing any local replacement of the two global moment conditions. The Z/3 by Z/5 determinant is 7/352; the general trace of the omitted mixed part is product_i f_i−2−product_i(f_i−2).

results.title: The complete cohomological image on the finite packet spectrum
results.claim: On P ordinal-sum Z, the relative group is C^Z tensor reduced H^(n−1)(P;W), and its image in ordinary cohomology is (C^Z/diagonal C) tensor that group. The kernel, cochain quotient, contraction, full original prime matrices and residue dual receiver are explicit. For d Boolean support points and c arithmetic points the ordinary degree-one dimension is (c−1)(d−1). This is the specified constant coefficient sheaf on the actual packet base; its map from the irreducible parent base is calculated.

results.title: A uniform Weil bound on every original finite prime-pulse face
results.claim: For every selected finite set of at least two primes and every complex coefficient vector, the original pulses obey Q_A(g_c) > (6600077509/144027072000) ||g_c||² > ||g_c||²/22 for nonzero c and every support face A. The proof retains the full Archimedean integral, all prime-power lags, original width and amplitudes; it strengthens the prior four-sign estimate.

results.title: Full mixed spectrum, every compression eigenspace, and all tensor signs
results.claim: The complete first mixed operator has spectrum [−s! rho_I product_i u_i, s! product_i u_i], no eigenvalues, and both sign spaces infinite-dimensional. Its exact pulse compression has inertia (binomial(2s,s)/2, binomial(2s,s)/2, (s+1)^s−binomial(2s,s)). The complementary map is injective on each compressed eigenspace, including its radical. Every higher tensor sign, finite trace, generating formula and exact exponential rate is evaluated through the original signed support diagonal.

scope: Complete proofs of the stated constructions. Full Weil positivity and RH are not proved.
